plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF

package.partial_encrypted_sections: optional deterministic [{lookup, frame_ordinal, decoded_size}]; absent or empty means none

source_policy.db2_map: Use the explicit build-70450 authenticated available-source path, expose its zero-filled backing only under this declared-skip revision, parse it with read_map_70450(), and preserve the bytes as the sole Map DB2 artifact.
source_policy.partial_sections: For each checksum-verified E frame, retain only the redacted lookup hex, frame ordinal, and decoded size. Require every wrapper to use cipher S and require the E-frame count to equal the Map source's tact_declared section count. TrinityCore-style HandleEncryptedSection skips each declared section; no key or decryption is used.
source_policy.terrain_map: Use the v20 build-70450 available Map projection; materialized rows with a non-zero WDT FileDataID retain v20 source order. Unknown TACT sections remain unknown and are not inferred from bytes.
source_policy.terrain_omissions: Only the v20 MissingFile-only WDT/root-ADT omission policy applies. Terrain conversion outcomes remain producer-reported.
source_policy.identity_boundary: Verification re-reads the sealed Map artifact with read_map_70450(), independently derives the number of tact_declared sections, and requires it to match the optional manifest declarations. The projection and its selected identities do not prove whole-client Map completeness or source decryption.

verification.verify_scope: offline package integrity, intrinsic DB2/MAPS formats, independently re-derived available Map identity and partial-section counts
verification.verify_links_scope: the same checks; no navigation or external package links are part of v25

acceptance_matrix.expect: admit only build 70450, mask 9, disabled keys, declared-skip, resident storage, one Map DB2 entry, terrain all or one map, and no navigation/map-domain/offmesh
accept zero-filled Map only when every E frame uses S and the frame count equals tact_declared sections; skip exactly declared sections and record redacted declarations
verify accepts declared partial Map, rejects undeclared partial data, inconsistent declaration counts, zero tact_declared sections with declarations, corrupt zerofill, and unsupported cipher
synthetic-only WDC5 with one readable and one tact_declared section exercises inspect, extract/resume, offline verify and verify-links
refuse keys, scratch, navigation, map-domain and off-mesh before client/output work

legacy_preservation: v20 terrain, v23 selected navigation and v24 authenticated Map terrain retain their existing plan, package and verification identities; v25 software admission transfers no prior real-client acceptance.
